root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the whitespace-skip result stays inside helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the `buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);` call, the returned pointer must remain strictly inside the logical request span `[helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len)`. The vulnerable original executes the call even when every remaining copied byte is whitespace, so the call result becomes the one-past-end pointer later dereferenced by the loop test.
root_cause_criterion.description: A bounded replay of `ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer)` over the logical request span shows the missing source obligation directly at the root-cause call site: the call result must stay in-bounds before parsing may continue.

nodes.state: At the crashy loop test, `buffer == helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len`, so evaluating `lwan_char_isspace(*buffer)` reads the first byte past the logical request span and past `data_copy[32766]`.

edges.relation: The exact pointer value that `ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer)` would return for the current request span is the same `buffer` later re-tested by the loop condition and dereferenced out of bounds.
